app_info.subtitle: Preview molecular structures
app_info.description: Burette opens supported molecular structure attachments and explicit public PDB entries as interactive 3D scenes, with bounded composition summaries for chains, residues, ligands, molecules, and elements.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one user-authorized attachment into memory and computes a bounded preview without saving or changing the file.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, send, revoke, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the explicitly requested public RCSB PDB entry and computes a bounded preview.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads public structure data without writing to RCSB or any other external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, send, revoke, or perform another irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only re-renders one explicitly supplied structure with bounded client-side viewer actions and does not save a workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Viewer actions affect only the isolated result widget and do not write to RCSB or another external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify the source file, persist a molecular edit, or perform an irreversible external action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Opens only an ephemeral in-memory editor surface and does not change the source file or write a workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: The editor is isolated to the current MCP widget and cannot publish content or contact third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool cannot delete, overwrite, or persist a file; persistence requires a separate user-confirmed action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Edits only the ephemeral Ketcher surface in the current widget; it never mutates the source attachment or local files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Revision-checked actions stay inside the isolated Burette relay and do not publish content or call third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Clear and replace affect only the transient widget state; saving stops at an explicit user-confirmation boundary.

test_cases.description: Preview a small attached PDB macromolecule.
test_cases.user_prompt: Preview this PDB file in the full molecular viewer and summarize its chains, residues, and atoms.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded PDB composition counts and opens the attached structure in the interactive Burette Mol* viewer.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open this mmCIF structure and show its chain and element summary.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded mmCIF counts and renders the structure with sequence and structure controls.

test_cases.user_prompt: Preview this SDF and summarize the molecules and elements it contains.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded SDF molecule and element counts and renders the available coordinates interactively.

test_cases.description: Select and focus a residue range in a public PDB scene.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open PDB 1CRN, select residues 10 through 20 in chain A, focus that selection, and hide water.
test_cases.expected_output: Re-renders 1CRN, selects and focuses the requested chain A residue range, hides water, and reports the bounded client-side action results.

test_cases.description: Retrieve an explicit public PDB entry.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open PDB 1CRN in the full molecular viewer and summarize its composition.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves 1CRN from RCSB, returns bounded composition counts, and renders the structure in the full interactive viewer.

test_cases.description: Open an ephemeral Ketcher editor with a small inline structure.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open a Ketcher editor and seed it with ethanol using the SMILES CCO.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an isolated revisioned Ketcher surface and renders the focused chemical editor without writing a file.

test_cases.description: Apply a revision-checked chemical edit in Ketcher.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the open Ketcher editor, replace the structure with CCO and return its SMILES.
test_cases.expected_output: Applies the edit to the current surface, returns a bounded snapshot and export, and leaves persistence to the user.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke a read-only preview tool for destructive local file editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete several atoms from my local PDB file and overwrite the original file.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it cannot edit, delete, or overwrite local molecular files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use a molecular preview as medical diagnosis.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Diagnose whether I have cancer from a protein structure.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because molecular visualization is not a medical diagnostic workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated three-dimensional asset formats.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Render this Blender OBJ model and edit its materials.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because general 3D assets and material editing are outside its molecular structure formats.
